acceptanceCriteria: Every Agent defined in layout.agents (Codex, Claude, Gemini, Grok) has an ExecutionFlow connector line to the Entry Gate, not only the first two.
3D labels are wrapped in a Billboard so they continuously face the camera and render correctly (not mirrored or upside-down) regardless of orbit angle.

A label whose owning element is dimmed (isDimmed true) is not rendered at all, rather than rendered at reduced opacity, so filtered contexts (Work Item stage selection, tour scenes, Verification scenarios) show only the labels relevant to the current highlighted set.
The Work Item envelope's own label has additional vertical clearance from the Contract element it can otherwise visually crowd.

npm ci, lint, typecheck, unit tests, Playwright e2e, and the static export build all succeed with no regression to camera stability, three-mode navigation, i18n coverage, or the Verified != Approved distinction established in prior WIs.
